title: low-fat luscious mexican pulled pork confit
description: Tender, flavorful pulled pork in a rich, coconut milk-based confit with a hint of Mexican spices.
instructions: Season the pork shoulder with salt, black pepper, cumin, and smoked paprika.
In a large Dutch oven, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium-high heat. Sear the pork shoulder until browned on all sides, about 2 minutes per side.
Add the onion and garlic to the pot and cook until the onion is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the chipotle peppers, tomato paste, and 1 cup of chicken broth to the pot, stirring to combine.
Transfer the pot to the preheated oven and braise the pork for 2 1/2 hours, or until tender and easily shredded with a fork.
Stir in the coconut milk and bring the pot to a simmer on the stovetop.
Shred the pork with two forks and stir to coat with the confit sauce.
Serve the pulled pork in small containers (about 1 cup each) in a bento box with your choice of sides.
